common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one exceptionally polished high-fidelity Windows desktop application UI design for DEPTH AI, a visual source-code module understanding, refactoring and integration program powered by Meta. This is a NEW visual direction derived solely from product functions. Do not use, recall, copy or imitate any previous reference images or earlier conversation images. No input reference images.
The interface itself fills the entire landscape 16:10 image, approximately 2400x1500; crisp product-quality typography, meticulous spacing, extraordinary graphic craft. No computer hardware, no room, no MR or VR, no perspective view of the whole screen, no game UI. It must look implementable in a normal desktop application, with readable front-facing text.
Invent a cohesive visual language: warm ivory application chrome and slim navigation rail surrounding a deep soft charcoal drafting surface. Physical-feeling CODE MODULES dominate the working area, not generic dashboard cards: compact precision-molded instrument-like bodies, shallow 4px raised edges, asymmetric clipped corners, small inset circular connection sockets, visible header/body/footer construction. Warm coral for behavior/functions, desaturated mint for state/data, lavender for structure/contracts, amber for image assets. Bodies have subtly colored satin faces, dark engraved-like labels and tiny readable source snippets. Tiny restrained highlights; no glass, neon, bloom, glossy black screens, photorealistic cables, ornamental cubes or meaningless futuristic geometry. Use thin tidy directed connectors routed through real sockets; selected path brighter, unrelated paths quieter. Comfortable negative space, clear hierarchy. Main area 65-75% of screen; navigation and inspectors compact and intentional. Large, genuinely legible key names and Korean headings, with short labels rather than walls of text.
Persistent shell: small DEPTH AI wordmark upper left, project selector, search and Meta chip at top; vertical slim nav with simple pictograms and short Korean labels for 지도, 이해, 분리, 통합, 에셋, 검토. Appropriate one active. Bottom minimal contextual toolbar for fit/zoom when a graph is present. No fabricated benchmark counters, green all-tests-passed claims, 100% confidence or token savings. Every image is a design proposal, not proof of an implemented or tested feature. Add a tiny unobtrusive 'DESIGN STUDY' label in the outer bottom chrome.
Distinct module silhouettes and meaningful ports/contents matter more than decorative backgrounds. Do not make a SaaS dashboard, card grid, marketing landing page, wireframe or a collage of screens. Show one completed beautiful application screen. Preserve consistent palette/material/type language across this eight-screen design family.

The right half is an elegant ivory explanation reading surface, not a chat dashboard: segmented control '초보자 / 중급자 / 숙련자', 초보자 selected; heading '왜 Queue를 사용했나요?'; concise Korean text '작업을 들어온 순서대로 꺼내기 위해 사용합니다.'; small example A → B → C; caution '빈 큐에서 Next()를 호출하면 예외가 발생합니다.' and provenance chip '소스 기반 해석'.
